name: krishi-market
description: Farmer-to-Consumer Agri Marketplace — Direct from local farms to your table

scripts.dev: kill-port 3000 5000 && concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=shared && npm run test --workspace=server && npm run test --workspace=client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=client && npm run lint --workspace=server
